page.overview:
Who is Mercenary on the Dock?

Mercenary on the Dock was one of Eli Mills' mercenaries in .

This mercenary was one of Eli Mills' mercenaries. He was sent with Ken Wheatley to help gather up the dinosaurs on Isla Nublar when Mount Sibo became active again. During the eruption he was seen ordering his fellow mercenaries to get on the boat as the volcano began to erupt. Seeing the last of the men on the boat the mercenary quickly made his escape onto the boat himself. As the Arcadia left the mercenary and his fellow team mates witnessed a lone Brachiosaurus on the ship's dock as she was killed by the volcano.
